Metadata.title: MICHI — Travel deeper. Leave lighter.
Metadata.description: Discover Japan with cultural understanding, destination care, and community benefit at the heart of every journey.

Landing.title: Travel deeper. Leave lighter.
Landing.description: Find experiences that fit you, learn the context, and make room for the people and places that welcome you.
Landing.regionTitle: Choose with the place in mind.
Landing.regionDescription: Three distinct places, with official context and a thoughtful way to explore.
Landing.pointOfViewTitle: Not just where to go. When, why and how matter too.
Landing.pointOfViewDescription: A meaningful journey considers what interests you and what a place is ready to share. MICHI brings those perspectives together before you choose.
Landing.startWithYouCopy: Begin with your interests, pace, and access needs.
Landing.understandPlaceCopy: See context and capacity alongside the experience.
Landing.meetWithCareCopy: Connect with local hosts on terms they set.
Landing.responsibleTitle: Your first choice is not your only good choice.
Landing.responsibleDescription: If visitor pressure is higher in your preferred destination, MICHI can help you compare relevant alternatives while keeping the decision yours.
Landing.recommendationPrinciple: Recommendations balance personal match, cultural depth, local benefit, accessibility, availability, and destination health. Deterministic code ranks results; AI does not choose the order.
Landing.pressureEvidenceTitle: Pressure and capacity are shown only when a dated, approved signal is available.
Landing.pressureEvidenceCopy: This catalogue has no connected live crowd feed or validated destination health scores. We keep those values unknown and link to official city guidance instead of implying live conditions.
Landing.healthTitle: A place has a rhythm. Travel with it.
Landing.healthDescription: Pressure, remaining capacity, community readiness, transport access, and seasonal suitability belong in the same conversation.
Landing.healthMissingCopy: Crowd pressure, remaining capacity, community readiness, transport access, and seasonal suitability are not connected to verified, time-stamped feeds yet.
Landing.experiencesTitle: Spend time with people who know this place.
Landing.experiencesDescription: Experiences should make context, participation, and host-set capacity clear before a visitor commits.
Landing.catalogueNotLoaded: Official operator listings will appear after the reviewed catalogue is loaded.
Landing.culturalDescription: MICHI is designed to explain reviewed evidence, not invent cultural answers. When reliable evidence is missing or conflicts, the right response is to say so.
Landing.geminiRole: Gemini may help explain retrieved sources. It is never the cultural database.
Landing.culturalEvidenceTitle: Every cultural answer needs a source, scope, and review date.
Landing.culturalEvidenceCopy: On experience pages, ask MICHI about the place or activity. Answers are grounded in retrieved records and should make uncertainty clear when evidence is missing, stale, or conflicting.
Landing.communityDescription: A welcome is not inventory. Hosts set the terms, and can change discovery visibility without removing existing confirmed bookings.
Landing.hostListingsStatus: No MICHI host listings are currently onboarded. External operator listings remain information-only until a host joins and verifies authorization.
Landing.consentCopy: Hosts choose what they share and the terms of participation.
Landing.capacityCopy: Availability and visitor limits stay under host control.
Landing.visibilityCopy: Hosts can pause discovery without removing confirmed bookings.
Landing.localValueCopy: Community-hosted experiences can create direct local value. MICHI does not yet measure those outcomes; future reporting should use verified, aggregated information and community consent.
Landing.journeyTitle: A journey with room to listen.
Landing.journeyDescription: A simple progression gives context before commitment, and reflection after the experience.
Landing.impactTitle: Measure what matters to the places that welcome us.
Landing.impactDescription: Future destination insights should help communities understand how tourism is experienced and where value reaches local hosts.
Landing.impactPlanned: Impact measures are planned; no metrics are connected or shown as achieved.
Landing.visitorDispersionCopy: Understand where visitors spend time across a destination.
Landing.communityBenefitCopy: Track whether local hosts see a fair share of visitor activity.
Landing.culturalUnderstandingCopy: Learn whether context and consent are clear before participation.
Landing.responsibleCapacityCopy: Compare visitor interest with capacity communities choose to share.
Landing.trustTitle: Know what is known — and who says so.
Landing.trustDescription: Information should carry its source, verification status, and freshness with it.
Landing.catalogueDisclosure: The public catalogue displays sourced official and operator records. MICHI does not currently publish host-provided or community-provided records.
Landing.nextStepCopy: Explore responsibly, with space for another point of view.

Plan.title: Plan a more considered journey.
Plan.description: MICHI scores eligible, verified records first. Gemini can arrange those database candidates, but it cannot add experiences or make up availability, health, prices, or travel times.
Plan.restoreNotice: Your guest itinerary is ready to review. Choose “Save this journey” below when you are ready to add it to your account.
Plan.private: Private unless you choose to share
Plan.refreshError: Saved journeys could not be refreshed.
Plan.catalogueError: Verified destinations could not load. Planning will be available when the source-backed catalogue responds.
Plan.dateHelp: Dates are used to check genuine MICHI-host slots.
Plan.where: Where would you like to begin?
Plan.placeHelp: Choose a current, officially sourced destination. Eligible candidates elsewhere in Japan may appear as alternatives.
Plan.noDestinations: No verified destinations are available to start from.
Plan.interestTitle: What would you like to spend time with?
Plan.budgetHelp: This is a per-experience ceiling in Japanese yen. Leave blank for no price ceiling.
Plan.accessTitle: What should the plan account for?
Plan.accessHelp: Only confirmed accessibility details count as a match. Unknown details are not treated as accessible.
Plan.dietaryDisclaimer: MICHI will not infer food safety or guarantee accommodations from an unverified listing.
Plan.crowdTitle: How much visitor pressure are you comfortable with?
Plan.crowdHelp: The recommendation engine uses verified health evidence when present. Missing health evidence remains unknown.
Plan.geminiPrivacy: First MICHI ranks eligible database candidates deterministically. Gemini may reorder only these candidates and choose among their listed reasons. It receives interest tags and travel style; dates, accessibility, dietary preferences, and budget are not sent to Gemini.
Plan.choosePlan: Choose what belongs in your plan
Plan.candidateScoring: Candidate eligibility and scores come from MICHI's deterministic engine. Gemini cannot add records or create reasons. Each selected MICHI slot is checked again before saving and is not booked by saving this itinerary.

Plan.savedAvailabilityNote: External listings save without a time or booking. Host availability is rechecked and not reserved.
Plan.guestDraftNote: After you choose Save journey, this browser keeps the draft for 24 hours so you can return after sign-in. Sign in is needed to save it to your account.

Plan.alternativeLimit: This is outside your chosen starting destination. MICHI has not calculated the travel distance or claimed this is a lower-pressure alternative.
Plan.notCalculated: MICHI does not calculate a score for a destination without an eligible database experience, and does not infer travel time or low visitor pressure.

Health.title: A clear view of current conditions.
Health.inverseNote: Crowd pressure is the only inverse input: higher pressure lowers the score. Other inputs are scored higher-is-better. MICHI does not use a missing value as zero.
Health.oldestInput: Oldest input used for this score: {date} (Asia/Tokyo)

Health.factor_communityReadiness: Community readiness is the main factor lowering this score ({value}/100).
Health.factor_transportAccessibility: Transport accessibility is the main factor lowering this score ({value}/100).
Health.factor_seasonalSuitability: Seasonal suitability is the main factor lowering this score ({value}/100).
